CustomField.description: The branded name for this donor's giving tier (e.g., Friend, Partner, Champion), pulled from the FQS Donor Grouping configuration in Setup → Custom Metadata Types. To rename a tier for all donors at once, update the Donor Grouping field on the matching FQS Donor Grouping record.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The display name for this donor's giving tier (e.g., Friend, Partner, Champion). Your administrator controls these names — updating a tier name in Setup automatically reflects here for all donors in that tier.
CustomField.label: Donor Grouping Name
